What if you were as tough as a tardigrade?
Meet the water bear. Half a millimeter.
Eight chubby legs. Lives in wet moss.
Dried out, it shrivels into a ball.
Frozen for thirty years? It woke up!
Squeezed harder than the deepest ocean.
Ten days in open space. Many survived!
A special protein shields its DNA.
Normal you in a blizzard? Brrr.
Frozen in ice? Pop out smiling!
Bottom of the ocean? No problem!
The catch? You'd have to dry up first.
So... where would you go first?
